Set exactly which landing pages mark website ads as web-to-app (sending people on to your app). The
prefixes replace the list; --clear empties it. Synced ads change right away.

Usage:
  voidhash ads settings web-to-app [prefix...] [flags]

Arguments:
  prefix  Landing page prefixes, such as example.app/start; they replace the list

Flags:
      --clear              Remove every prefix
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API object as JSON, for scripts
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash ads settings web-to-app example.app/start
  voidhash ads settings web-to-app example.app/start example.app/get
  voidhash ads settings web-to-app --clear
